summary: Blocks within igloo basements can generate waterlogged when generating in close proximity to water
description:
## The Bug:

Blocks within igloo basements can generate waterlogged when generating in close proximity to water.

This issue can most commonly be seen with ladders in igloo basements, but also more rarely occurs with other blocks within the basements as well, such as iron bars.

Here is an example:

Version: 1.19.4

Seed: -2178309719778189280
Coordinates: /execute in minecraft:overworld run tp @s 318147.98 30.00 -1419.00 390.27 -66.60 

## Steps to Reproduce:

 - Generate a world with the seed provided above and teleport to the given coordinates.

 - Look at the blocks within the igloo closely.

 - Take note as to whether or not blocks within igloo basements can generate waterlogged when generating in close proximity to water.

## Observed Behavior:

Blocks can generate waterlogged.

## Expected Behavior:

Blocks would not be able to generate waterlogged.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft version 1.19.4.
2. Generate a world using the seed `-2178309719778189280`.
3. Teleport to the example location by running `/execute in minecraft:overworld run tp @s 318147.98 30.00 -1419.00 390.27 -66.60`.
4. Look closely at the blocks within the igloo basement, especially the ladders and other blocks such as iron bars.
5. Observe whether any blocks within the igloo basement have generated waterlogged when the igloo is close to water.
Environment: Minecraft Java Edition Versions: 1.15.1, 1.15.2 Pre-Release 1, 1.15.2 Pre-release 2, 1.16.2 Pre-release 1, 1.16.2, 20w51a, 1.16.5, 21w05b, 21w06a, 21w08b, 21w10a, 1.17.1, 21w37a, 21w38a, 21w42a, 21w43a, 1.18 Pre-release 2, 1.18 Release Candidate 4, 1.18, 1.18.1, 1.19, 1.19.2, 22w42a, 1.19.3, 1.19.4, 23w33a, 24w11a, 24w19b, 24w21b (includes snapshots)
Observed Behavior: When an igloo basement generates close to an existing water source, some of its blocks are created with their `waterlogged` block state set to `true`. Ladders are affected most often, although other waterloggable basement blocks, such as iron bars, can also be affected. As a result, these blocks contain water immediately after the igloo generates, even though the structure itself does not intentionally place water in those blocks.
Expected Behavior: When an igloo basement generates near water, its blocks should remain in their intended, non-waterlogged states. Ladders and other basement blocks, including iron bars, should not contain water or become waterlogged solely because the igloo is generated close to a water source. This behavior should be consistent across igloo basements generated in similar conditions.
